title: Rust SCHC exposes obsolete v2 and contradictory window-size constants
description: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs is a public module now implementing canonical Rule Set Version 3 fragmentation Rules 0x78/0x79, but its module doc still says Rule Set Version 2. It also publicly exports DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE=32 and MAX_WINDOW_SIZE=62 while the normative fixed WINDOW_SIZE is 63 tiles; MAX_WINDOW_SIZE is unused and Python exports 63 under the same name. Downstream users can select an invalid non-profile window or infer only 62 tiles. Remove/rename obsolete constants or make all public window-size APIs represent the fixed 63-tile profile, update module docs to version 3, and add a public-constant/profile consistency test.
